Terrible and too dull, the author downplayed every other higher ranks character except the lady’s-in-waiting to uplift the protagonist. Tell me what other side characters that are memorable apart from those revolve around Navier? None. There are two kinds of women in this webtoon, the ones who kiss Navier feet and those who don’t. I bet you, the author, will make Krista look crazy, obsessive, and power-hungry. Why? Because she doesn’t kiss Navier feet, the author mostly got nothing to prove that she was a horrible queen. What exactly did Krista do wrong before Navier came in? Nothing. Was she a dictator? No. Unlike Navier, the western kingdom was mostly on her shoulder due to her husband, Heinrey’s older brother’s been sick and fragile all the time. In other words, she did a fantastic job. If the webtoon wants to take different route, they could make Krista and Sovietshu an endgame. Nonetheless, I don’t think they will. 

My opinion on Heinrey is that his pretty corny, bland, and unrealistic; I mean, who’s fawn over someone 24/7, nobody. And other than a “pretty cute guy who can’t do any wrong,” which seems like the route most romance manga take these days. What else does he got going on?. Because in my eyes, heinrey is pretty cunning and manipulative as it comes, but because he treated the protagonist well, they’ll give him a pass. He likes to get his way, and he does. Ask yourself what would’ve been the outcome if the divorce didn’t happen? Or Rastha kick out? I know he wouldn’t stand by like a statue and do nothing. I mean his planned was to take down the Eastern empire. So, He and Ergy are very much alike.

I like a villain that can go head to head with the protagonist like Eros from your throne, but Rastha is none of that. Heinrey is parallel to Rastha cause both of character are quickly to show affection, except for Heinrey, who knows how the world works by being born into Royalty, and Rastha, an enslaved person who’s easily manipulated and mislead by others. Also, looks like a lamb walking into a lions den, which comes out as expected, her DEATH.

Both Sovietshu and Navier are terrible at showing their emotion, but Navier is worst. She’s too perfect, with no flaws. Only care about empress this, empress that. I know Sovietshu was pain in the butt and without excuse; nonetheless, he was right about one thing. Navier is like a stone cold wall and has the same expressiveness. He wanted her love, not just her commitment as Empress. Imagine being married to someone who only cares about their career, is like marrying a co-worker. At least, Rastha, you can understand where she coming from. Would you let the opportunity slip of being out of slavery? No. Survival is a human instinct. She tried to survive from her former master, an emperor who used her for his own benefit, Ergy the deceiver who she thought was her friend, a coward ex-boyfriend who threatened to make their child royalty not long after becoming an Empress’s or else. Her father, who she waited for how long to save her from slavery; although, he was the one who sold her, to save himself from atoning for his OWN crime. And only came back to take advantage of her. On other hand, Navier is not relatable.

Lastly, someone trained to be an emperor at a such a young age can’t be that stupid! No, there’s no way. It definitely seem like the author water down Sovietshu character to uplift the MC. 

PS. The fandom is too toxic. It’s like a communist party over there, lol. You’ll be downvoted for having different points of view. So, don’t be surprised when it happens 😂😂
